# RADIX Robotics

RADIX Robotics installs world-class composite skill laboratories inside schools, empowering students with robotics, AI, drones, and advanced STEM education across India.

## Key Offerings
- Turnkey composite skill labs for Indian schools
- NEP 2020 compliant curriculum
- Autonomous systems, Drones, IoT, and Edge AI
- Complete physical infrastructure setup
- Resident engineer support and teacher training

## Contact
- Website: https://radixrobotics.com
- Email: contact@radixrobotics.com

## About
We partner with schools to bring cutting-edge hardware and curriculum straight to their campuses, turning students into active robotics creators and tech pioneers.
